title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for coupled stiff transport systems
summary: Purpose: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) struggle with stiff, regime-changing transport equations due to instability, loss imbalance, and violations of physical consistency. This paper investigates these failures through the Marshak wave equations - a canonical benchmark from radiative transport - where initial and boundary conditions differ by up to 12 orders of magnitude, and proposes targeted modifications to the standard PINN framework to overcome them.
